title: 可開合體育場屋頂
subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
summary: 可開合屋頂同時是大跨度鋼結構與一部大型行走機械：固定主結構承受軌道與移動屋面板，轉向架把輪壓傳入軌道梁，驅動與制動在限定風速下讓屋面板同步移動。本課以多倫多 SkyDome（今 Rogers Centre）、亞特蘭大賓士體育場、溫布頓中央球場與福岡巨蛋為例，建立狀態荷載、輪壓、驅動功率、偏斜控制、試運轉與長期維護的工程判斷。
summaryEn: A retractable roof is both a long-span steel structure and a large travelling machine: the fixed primary structure carries rails and moving panels, bogies deliver wheel loads into rail girders, and drives and brakes move the panels in step below a set wind speed. Using Toronto's SkyDome (now Rogers Centre), Atlanta's Mercedes-Benz Stadium, Wimbledon's Centre Court and Fukuoka Dome, the course builds engineering judgement on state-dependent loads, wheel loads, drive power, skew control, commissioning and long-term maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

labelsEn: Fixed primary structure and rail girders

architectureNodes: Fixed primary structure and rail girders

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合」與「移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load combinations for open, closed and moving states" and "Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load combinations for open, closed and moving states: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「運轉風速門檻」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Operating wind limit” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 可開合屋頂至少有三種結構狀態：全閉、全開停放，以及正在移動。停放狀態的屋面板由夾軌器或鎖定裝置固定，必須承受設計回歸期的風與雪；移動狀態下屋面板只靠車輪與驅動器約束，因此業主會訂出運轉風速上限，超過就不得開合。溫布頓中央球場的移動屋頂設計採用百年回歸期的雪與風，並規定約 25 m/s 以上不運轉；Rogers Centre 的屋頂則要求在約 40 mph 的風中仍能操作。設計者必須把每一種狀態都列成獨立的荷載組合，而不是只算一個「完成後」的模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「運轉風速門檻」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A retractable roof has at least three structural states: fully closed, fully open and parked, and moving. When parked, panels are held by rail clamps or locking devices and must resist design-return-period wind and snow; while moving they are restrained only by wheels and drives, so owners set an operating wind limit above which the roof may not move. Wimbledon's Centre Court moving roof was designed for 1-in-100-year snow and wind and is not operated above about 25 m/s, while Rogers Centre's roof is required to operate in winds up to about 40 mph. Each state must be listed as its own load combination rather than relying on a single as-built model. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Operating wind limit” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風壓 q = ½ρV²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind pressure q = ½ρV².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「運轉風速門檻」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Operating wind limit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合
knowledge.titleEn: Load combinations for open, closed and moving states
knowledge.text: 可開合屋頂至少有三種結構狀態：全閉、全開停放，以及正在移動。停放狀態的屋面板由夾軌器或鎖定裝置固定，必須承受設計回歸期的風與雪；移動狀態下屋面板只靠車輪與驅動器約束，因此業主會訂出運轉風速上限，超過就不得開合。
knowledge.textEn: A retractable roof has at least three structural states: fully closed, fully open and parked, and moving. When parked, panels are held by rail clamps or locking devices and must resist design-return-period wind and snow; while moving they are restrained only by wheels and drives, so owners set an operating wind limit above which the roof may not move.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load combinations for open, closed and moving states" is correct?
options: 可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。
可開合屋頂至少有三種結構狀態：全閉、全開停放，以及正在移動。
軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。
optionsEn: A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position.
A retractable roof has at least three structural states: fully closed, fully open and parked, and moving.
Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry.
quiz.explanation: 可開合屋頂至少有三種結構狀態：全閉、全開停放，以及正在移動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A retractable roof has at least three structural states: fully closed, fully open and parked, and moving. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load combinations for open, closed and moving states: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「運轉風速門檻」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Operating wind limit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風壓 q = ½ρV²。運轉上限 V = 25 m/s 時 q = 0.5×1.225×25² ≈ 383 Pa；停放設計風速 V = 45 m/s 時 q ≈ 1,240 Pa，兩者相差 (45/25)² = 3.24 倍，所以移動機構只需承受約 1/3 的風壓，但停放鎖定必須承擔全部設計風力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind pressure q = ½ρV². At an operating limit of V = 25 m/s, q = 0.5×1.225×25² ≈ 383 Pa; at a parked design speed of V = 45 m/s, q ≈ 1,240 Pa, a ratio of (45/25)² = 3.24, so the travelling machinery sees about one third of the design pressure while the parking locks must carry the full design wind force. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在設計基準文件中列出每一狀態（全閉、全開、移動中、停在中間位置）的風、雪、溫度與地震組合，並要求風洞試驗分別提供開啟與閉合幾何下的壓力係數；審查時逐一核對驅動與鎖定元件是否各自對應正確的狀態荷載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List the wind, snow, temperature and seismic combinations for each state in the design basis (closed, open, moving and stopped part-way), and require the wind-tunnel study to give pressure coefficients for both open and closed geometries; at review, check that every drive and locking component is sized for the correct state load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 風壓 q = ½ρV²。運轉上限 V = 25 m/s 時 q = 0.5×1.225×25² ≈ 383 Pa；停放設計風速 V = 45 m/s 時 q ≈ 1,240 Pa，兩者相差 (45/25)² = 3.24 倍，所以移動機構只需承受約 1/3 的風壓，但停放鎖定必須承擔全部設計風力。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wind pressure q = ½ρV². At an operating limit of V = 25 m/s, q = 0.5×1.225×25² ≈ 383 Pa; at a parked design speed of V = 45 m/s, q ≈ 1,240 Pa, a ratio of (45/25)² = 3.24, so the travelling machinery sees about one third of the design pressure while the parking locks must carry the full design wind force. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load combinations for open, closed and moving states", which statement holds?
options: 屋面板很重，所以靜止時本身重量就足以抵抗風力，不需要停車制動。
兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。
風壓 q = ½ρV²。
optionsEn: Panels are so heavy that their weight alone resists wind when parked, so no parking brake is needed.
If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback.
Wind pressure q = ½ρV².
quiz.explanation: 風壓 q = ½ρV²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wind pressure q = ½ρV². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load combinations for open, closed and moving states: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「運轉風速門檻」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Operating wind limit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在設計基準文件中列出每一狀態（全閉、全開、移動中、停在中間位置）的風、雪、溫度與地震組合，並要求風洞試驗分別提供開啟與閉合幾何下的壓力係數；審查時逐一核對驅動與鎖定元件是否各自對應正確的狀態荷載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List the wind, snow, temperature and seismic combinations for each state in the design basis (closed, open, moving and stopped part-way), and require the wind-tunnel study to give pressure coefficients for both open and closed geometries; at review, check that every drive and locking component is sized for the correct state load. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主需求書應明訂運轉風速上限、量測位置與平均時間（陣風或十分鐘平均），並規定中途停車時的鎖定能力；這些數字要同時寫進結構計算書與操作手冊，由結構工程師與機械設計者共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner's requirements should state the operating wind limit, its measurement location and averaging time (gust or ten-minute mean), and the locking capacity when stopped part-way; the same numbers belong in both the structural calculations and the operating manual, signed off jointly by the structural engineer and the mechanism designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用閉合狀態做風洞與設計，開啟時屋面板邊緣與看台上方的負壓與漩渦可能遠大於預期；屋面板停在中間位置時遇到陣風，夾軌器若未設計成可在任意位置鎖定，屋面板可能被推動或產生上揚。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the wind-tunnel study and design use only the closed geometry, suction and vortices at panel edges and over the stands when open can far exceed expectations; if a gust arrives while a panel is stopped part-way and the rail clamps cannot lock at arbitrary positions, the panel may be pushed along or lifted. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在設計基準文件中列出每一狀態（全閉、全開、移動中、停在中間位置）的風、雪、溫度與地震組合，並要求風洞試驗分別提供開啟與閉合幾何下的壓力係數；審查時逐一核對驅動與鎖定元件是否各自對應正確的狀態荷載。
knowledge.textEn: List the wind, snow, temperature and seismic combinations for each state in the design basis (closed, open, moving and stopped part-way), and require the wind-tunnel study to give pressure coefficients for both open and closed geometries; at review, check that every drive and locking component is sized for the correct state load.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主需求書應明訂運轉風速上限、量測位置與平均時間（陣風或十分鐘平均），並規定中途停車時的鎖定能力；這些數字要同時寫進結構計算書與操作手冊，由結構工程師與機械設計者共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The owner's requirements should state the operating wind limit, its measurement location and averaging time (gust or ten-minute mean), and the locking capacity when stopped part-way; the same numbers belong in both the structural calculations and the operating manual, signed off jointly by the structural engineer and the mechanism designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load combinations for open, closed and moving states"?
options: 在設計基準文件中列出每一狀態（全閉、全開、移動中、停在中間位置）的風、雪、溫度與地震組合，並要求風洞試驗分別提供開啟與閉合幾何下的壓力係數。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。
optionsEn: List the wind, snow, temperature and seismic combinations for each state in the design basis (closed, open, moving and stopped part-way), and require the wind-tunnel study to give pressure coefficients for both open and closed geometries.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe.
quiz.explanation: 在設計基準文件中列出每一狀態（全閉、全開、移動中、停在中間位置）的風、雪、溫度與地震組合，並要求風洞試驗分別提供開啟與閉合幾何下的壓力係數；審查時逐一核對驅動與鎖定元件是否各自對應正確的狀態荷載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List the wind, snow, temperature and seismic combinations for each state in the design basis (closed, open, moving and stopped part-way), and require the wind-tunnel study to give pressure coefficients for both open and closed geometries; at review, check that every drive and locking component is sized for the correct state load. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load combinations for open, closed and moving states: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「運轉風速門檻」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Operating wind limit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只用閉合狀態做風洞與設計，開啟時屋面板邊緣與看台上方的負壓與漩渦可能遠大於預期；屋面板停在中間位置時遇到陣風，夾軌器若未設計成可在任意位置鎖定，屋面板可能被推動或產生上揚。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the wind-tunnel study and design use only the closed geometry, suction and vortices at panel edges and over the stands when open can far exceed expectations; if a gust arrives while a panel is stopped part-way and the rail clamps cannot lock at arbitrary positions, the panel may be pushed along or lifted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計者必須把每一種狀態都列成獨立的荷載組合，而不是只算一個「完成後」的模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each state must be listed as its own load combination rather than relying on a single as-built model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只用閉合狀態做風洞與設計，開啟時屋面板邊緣與看台上方的負壓與漩渦可能遠大於預期；屋面板停在中間位置時遇到陣風，夾軌器若未設計成可在任意位置鎖定，屋面板可能被推動或產生上揚。
knowledge.textEn: If the wind-tunnel study and design use only the closed geometry, suction and vortices at panel edges and over the stands when open can far exceed expectations; if a gust arrives while a panel is stopped part-way and the rail clamps cannot lock at arbitrary positions, the panel may be pushed along or lifted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load combinations for open, closed and moving states" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只用閉合狀態做風洞與設計，開啟時屋面板邊緣與看台上方的負壓與漩渦可能遠大於預期。
軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If the wind-tunnel study and design use only the closed geometry, suction and vortices at panel edges and over the stands when open can far exceed expectations.
Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry.
quiz.explanation: 若只用閉合狀態做風洞與設計，開啟時屋面板邊緣與看台上方的負壓與漩渦可能遠大於預期；屋面板停在中間位置時遇到陣風，夾軌器若未設計成可在任意位置鎖定，屋面板可能被推動或產生上揚。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the wind-tunnel study and design use only the closed geometry, suction and vortices at panel edges and over the stands when open can far exceed expectations; if a gust arrives while a panel is stopped part-way and the rail clamps cannot lock at arbitrary positions, the panel may be pushed along or lifted. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「固定主桁架與軌道梁」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Primary trusses and rail girders” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 移動屋面板本身是一個可自行站立的鋼結構，透過轉向架坐在軌道上；軌道梁再把輪壓傳給固定主桁架或拱，最後經支柱進入基礎。關鍵在於主結構的撓度會隨屋面板位置改變：屋面板移到跨中時，主桁架下垂最大，軌道坡度也跟著改變。賓士體育場以 4 道跨距約 220 m、深約 21 m 的主桁架支撐 8 片花瓣狀屋面板；溫布頓的移動桁架跨距約 77 m。設計必須讓軌道在各種位置下的高程差、坡度與軌距變化都落在機構可容許的範圍內。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「固定主桁架與軌道梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each moving panel is a self-supporting steel structure seated on rails through bogies; rail girders pass the wheel loads to fixed primary trusses or arches and then through columns to the foundations. The critical point is that primary-structure deflection changes with panel position: when a panel moves to mid-span, the truss sags most and the rail gradient changes with it. Mercedes-Benz Stadium supports eight petal panels on four primary trusses spanning about 220 m and about 21 m deep, while Wimbledon's moving trusses span about 77 m. The design must keep rail level differences, gradients and gauge changes within what the mechanism tolerates for every panel position. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Primary trusses and rail girders” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以拋物線近似主桁架撓曲，跨距 L = 220 m、撓度限值 L/400 時 δ = 0.55 m，支點附近的軌道附加坡度 θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010，也就是 1%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Approximating the truss deflection as a parabola with span L = 220 m and a limit of L/400 gives δ = 0.55 m, so the added rail gradient near the supports is θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010, or 1%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「固定主桁架與軌道梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Primary trusses and rail girders”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容
knowledge.titleEn: Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels
knowledge.text: 移動屋面板本身是一個可自行站立的鋼結構，透過轉向架坐在軌道上；軌道梁再把輪壓傳給固定主桁架或拱，最後經支柱進入基礎。關鍵在於主結構的撓度會隨屋面板位置改變：屋面板移到跨中時，主桁架下垂最大，軌道坡度也跟著改變。
knowledge.textEn: Each moving panel is a self-supporting steel structure seated on rails through bogies; rail girders pass the wheel loads to fixed primary trusses or arches and then through columns to the foundations. The critical point is that primary-structure deflection changes with panel position: when a panel moves to mid-span, the truss sags most and the rail gradient changes with it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels" is correct?
options: 軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。
只要車輪數量乘上單輪容量大於屋面板重量，輪壓就一定安全。
移動屋面板本身是一個可自行站立的鋼結構，透過轉向架坐在軌道上；軌道梁再把輪壓傳給固定主桁架或拱，最後經支柱進入基礎。
optionsEn: Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry.
If the number of wheels times the single-wheel capacity exceeds the panel weight, the wheel loads are safe.
Each moving panel is a self-supporting steel structure seated on rails through bogies.
quiz.explanation: 移動屋面板本身是一個可自行站立的鋼結構，透過轉向架坐在軌道上；軌道梁再把輪壓傳給固定主桁架或拱，最後經支柱進入基礎。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each moving panel is a self-supporting steel structure seated on rails through bogies; rail girders pass the wheel loads to fixed primary trusses or arches and then through columns to the foundations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「固定主桁架與軌道梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Primary trusses and rail girders” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線近似主桁架撓曲，跨距 L = 220 m、撓度限值 L/400 時 δ = 0.55 m，支點附近的軌道附加坡度 θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010，也就是 1%。這 1% 坡度會直接加到驅動器需要克服的爬坡阻力上。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Approximating the truss deflection as a parabola with span L = 220 m and a limit of L/400 gives δ = 0.55 m, so the added rail gradient near the supports is θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010, or 1%. That 1% gradient adds directly to the climbing resistance the drives must overcome. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分析模型把屋面板放在每一個停靠點與中間位置，輸出軌道沿線的高程、坡度與兩側軌道的相對位移，與機構設計者提供的容許值逐點比較；完工後以精密水準測量在無屋面板、屋面板停在不同位置時各量一次軌頂高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place the panels at every stop and intermediate position in the analysis model, output rail elevation, gradient and relative displacement between paired rails along the run, and compare point by point with the mechanism designer's tolerances; after completion survey rail-top levels by precise levelling with no panel present and with panels parked at several positions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以拋物線近似主桁架撓曲，跨距 L = 220 m、撓度限值 L/400 時 δ = 0.55 m，支點附近的軌道附加坡度 θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010，也就是 1%。這 1% 坡度會直接加到驅動器需要克服的爬坡阻力上。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Approximating the truss deflection as a parabola with span L = 220 m and a limit of L/400 gives δ = 0.55 m, so the added rail gradient near the supports is θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010, or 1%. That 1% gradient adds directly to the climbing resistance the drives must overcome. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels", which statement holds?
options: 以拋物線近似主桁架撓曲，跨距 L = 220 m、撓度限值 L/400 時 δ = 0.55 m，支點附近的軌道附加坡度 θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010，也就是 1%。
只要吊裝重量低於起重機額定荷重，風速多大都可以吊。
屋面板在工廠組裝試轉過，現場只要通電就能正式開合。
optionsEn: Approximating the truss deflection as a parabola with span L = 220 m and a limit of L/400 gives δ = 0.55 m, so the added rail gradient near the supports is θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010, or 1%.
If the lift weight is below the crane rating, lifting can proceed in any wind.
Panels trial-run in the factory can be opened and closed for real as soon as power is connected on site.
quiz.explanation: 以拋物線近似主桁架撓曲，跨距 L = 220 m、撓度限值 L/400 時 δ = 0.55 m，支點附近的軌道附加坡度 θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010，也就是 1%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Approximating the truss deflection as a parabola with span L = 220 m and a limit of L/400 gives δ = 0.55 m, so the added rail gradient near the supports is θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010, or 1%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「固定主桁架與軌道梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Primary trusses and rail girders” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分析模型把屋面板放在每一個停靠點與中間位置，輸出軌道沿線的高程、坡度與兩側軌道的相對位移，與機構設計者提供的容許值逐點比較；完工後以精密水準測量在無屋面板、屋面板停在不同位置時各量一次軌頂高程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place the panels at every stop and intermediate position in the analysis model, output rail elevation, gradient and relative displacement between paired rails along the run, and compare point by point with the mechanism designer's tolerances; after completion survey rail-top levels by precise levelling with no panel present and with panels parked at several positions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把「軌道幾何容許值表」列為結構與機械之間的正式介面文件，任何主結構變更（增加吊掛荷重、看板）都要重算軌道撓度並由機構設計者確認，例如賓士體育場屋架另承受約 1,000 t 的環形看板。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make a rail-geometry tolerance table the formal interface document between structure and machinery; any change to the primary structure, such as added rigging loads or scoreboards, must trigger a recalculation of rail deflection confirmed by the mechanism designer, as at Mercedes-Benz Stadium where the roof also carries a halo board of about 1,000 t.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：主桁架撓度造成兩側軌道下垂量不同時，屋面板會被扭曲，車輪輪緣頂住軌道側面，驅動電流急升甚至跳脫；長期下來輪緣與軌道側面磨耗不均，屋面板閉合時兩片之間出現縫隙而漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When truss deflection makes paired rails sag by different amounts, the panel is twisted, wheel flanges bear against the rail sides and drive current jumps or trips; over time flanges and rail sides wear unevenly and gaps open between panels when closed, letting water in. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以分析模型把屋面板放在每一個停靠點與中間位置，輸出軌道沿線的高程、坡度與兩側軌道的相對位移，與機構設計者提供的容許值逐點比較；完工後以精密水準測量在無屋面板、屋面板停在不同位置時各量一次軌頂高程。
knowledge.textEn: Place the panels at every stop and intermediate position in the analysis model, output rail elevation, gradient and relative displacement between paired rails along the run, and compare point by point with the mechanism designer's tolerances; after completion survey rail-top levels by precise levelling with no panel present and with panels parked at several positions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把「軌道幾何容許值表」列為結構與機械之間的正式介面文件，任何主結構變更（增加吊掛荷重、看板）都要重算軌道撓度並由機構設計者確認，例如賓士體育場屋架另承受約 1,000 t 的環形看板。
knowledge.textEn: Make a rail-geometry tolerance table the formal interface document between structure and machinery; any change to the primary structure, such as added rigging loads or scoreboards, must trigger a recalculation of rail deflection confirmed by the mechanism designer, as at Mercedes-Benz Stadium where the roof also carries a halo board of about 1,000 t.

quiz.question: 要驗證「移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels"?

以分析模型把屋面板放在每一個停靠點與中間位置，輸出軌道沿線的高程、坡度與兩側軌道的相對位移，與機構設計者提供的容許值逐點比較。

quiz.explanationEn: Place the panels at every stop and intermediate position in the analysis model, output rail elevation, gradient and relative displacement between paired rails along the run, and compare point by point with the mechanism designer's tolerances; after completion survey rail-top levels by precise levelling with no panel present and with panels parked at several positions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「固定主桁架與軌道梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Primary trusses and rail girders” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 主桁架撓度造成兩側軌道下垂量不同時，屋面板會被扭曲，車輪輪緣頂住軌道側面，驅動電流急升甚至跳脫；長期下來輪緣與軌道側面磨耗不均，屋面板閉合時兩片之間出現縫隙而漏水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: When truss deflection makes paired rails sag by different amounts, the panel is twisted, wheel flanges bear against the rail sides and drive current jumps or trips; over time flanges and rail sides wear unevenly and gaps open between panels when closed, letting water in. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計必須讓軌道在各種位置下的高程差、坡度與軌距變化都落在機構可容許的範圍內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design must keep rail level differences, gradients and gauge changes within what the mechanism tolerates for every panel position.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 主桁架撓度造成兩側軌道下垂量不同時，屋面板會被扭曲，車輪輪緣頂住軌道側面，驅動電流急升甚至跳脫；長期下來輪緣與軌道側面磨耗不均，屋面板閉合時兩片之間出現縫隙而漏水。
knowledge.textEn: When truss deflection makes paired rails sag by different amounts, the panel is twisted, wheel flanges bear against the rail sides and drive current jumps or trips; over time flanges and rail sides wear unevenly and gaps open between panels when closed, letting water in.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要車輪數量乘上單輪容量大於屋面板重量，輪壓就一定安全。
主桁架撓度造成兩側軌道下垂量不同時，屋面板會被扭曲，車輪輪緣頂住軌道側面，驅動電流急升甚至跳脫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If the number of wheels times the single-wheel capacity exceeds the panel weight, the wheel loads are safe.
When truss deflection makes paired rails sag by different amounts, the panel is twisted, wheel flanges bear against the rail sides and drive current jumps or trips.
quiz.explanation: 主桁架撓度造成兩側軌道下垂量不同時，屋面板會被扭曲，車輪輪緣頂住軌道側面，驅動電流急升甚至跳脫；長期下來輪緣與軌道側面磨耗不均，屋面板閉合時兩片之間出現縫隙而漏水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When truss deflection makes paired rails sag by different amounts, the panel is twisted, wheel flanges bear against the rail sides and drive current jumps or trips; over time flanges and rail sides wear unevenly and gaps open between panels when closed, letting water in. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
